title: API keys: scopes people can set (picker on Settings, scopes on key creation, narrow default)
body:
`tenancy::keys` supports `scopes {models, actions}` (actions checked: inference, models, balance, billing, accounts), but the website's key form and the API make only unscoped keys, and the action names don't cover traces, keys, runs, or plugins.

Fix: the public scope set in docs/api/design.md section 2.7 (responses, models:read, usage:read, traces, threads, runs, plugins, keys, billing, workspace), mapped from today's actions; a picker on Settings, API keys; `scopes` on `POST /v1/workspaces/{ws}/keys`; new keys default to `responses models:read usage:read`; existing keys keep working.

See docs/api/design.md, section 2.7, section 6 item 6, section 8 step 4.
